segments.note: This is where our oysters come from. The Outer Banks in North Carolina. Hand-picked at low tide. When it's high tide, we take them out with the crane, on the ice within an hour and at your door overnight.
These are sweet and briny, and the water's so clean, the dolphins are swimming with us. (2nd take of 'These are the freshest, saltiest oysters')
CTA: If you want a chance to win a fresh batch of oysters, comment oysters and I'll send you the link.
